items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Supported revenue exists only for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI spend for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 is $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls, conflicting with a prior record of $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned; hosting, domains, labor, marketing, experiment, and other operating costs are absent; incremental outcomes are not isolated; and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Continue only the existing reconciliation workstream. Do not authorize discretionary spend, commitments, forecasts, monetization expansion, requeues, new production work, or unsupported revenue claims. Minimum measurement is one reconciled AI-cost ledger, a period-aligned operating-cost ledger, canonical site/content attribution for commission, and isolated incremental outcomes linked to each intervention.
